correctness.rationale: The separate exact replay /workspace/branches/cd793f49-369a-49ba-a084-908269ef5008/reproduce_klein.py (output reproduction.txt in the same directory) checked F=h=0, tangent normalization and all 2024 triples. It reproduced the nine norm frequencies and confirmed every norm is nonzero with prime support in {2,7}. A triple determinant zero at any prime above p would force p to divide its integer norm. Thus for all claimed p the reduced vectors are nonzero, no two are proportional and no triple is concurrent. Their contact points are nonzero because the reduced gradients are nonzero, and they are distinct by their distinct tangents. On XYZ≠0, multiplying the gradient coordinates by X,Y,Z gives the 3-by-3 cyclic linear system of determinant 28 in the three defining monomials; the three points with a zero coordinate are smooth directly. The smooth plane curve is geometrically irreducible, and F does not divide h (specialize X=0). In characteristic at least five the Hessian criterion follows in local coordinates with tangent y=0: its determinant at the point is a nonzero multiple of the x² coefficient, zero exactly for contact at least three. Bézout exhausts the flexes with 24 distinct contacts. The reduced pair-to-intersection map is bijective, so the 276 ordinary nodes and the Frobenius counts follow from the same permutations as in characteristic zero. The replay checked fixed pairs 276,3,3,3,3,24 at residues 1 through 6, and orbit counts 3,0,7,42 at lengths 1,2,3,6 respectively. A length-six orbit requires the full cyclotomic field. Natural prime densities follow from the prime number theorem in arithmetic progressions modulo 7, not merely infinitude in each class. These are exact finite certificate and proof checks, not a formal certification or assertions at the excluded primes.

evidence: Pacini–Testa describe the degree-24 inflection scheme as a complete intersection. Pokora–Roé count 21 quadruple and 28 triple points of a different 21-line arrangement. Dimca et al. give the 24 order-one flexes, not the same line-pair incidence census.

claim_vs_prior_implication.reasoning: The pair spectrum is not an independent novelty over the characteristic-zero incidence and flex-action data. The complete norm support closes this gap and makes the same counts uniformly applicable.
